svg.title: Draw it: five free pictures, and one borrowed backbone
svg.desc: A large empty dashed frame for the student to draw in, with three instructions underneath: draw one 8 by 8 digit and its four shifted copies with the blanked edge shaded; write the row counts on both piles, 6,285 training rows and 540 test rows that were never shifted; and draw the backbone greyed out with the new head bolted on and the two weight counts written down.
svg.text: Draw it: five free pictures, and one borrowed backbone
1. one 8 × 8 digit, then its four shifted copies, with the blanked edge shaded
2. the row counts on both piles: 6,285 training rows and 540 test rows, never shifted
3. the backbone greyed out, the new head drawn on, and the two weight counts written down
